description: The bar chart, titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," compares the performance of two models—LLaMA-3-8B-it (represented by blue bars) and Ours (Iterative RLHF, represented by orange bars)—across nine different datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis lists these benchmarks, including GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, while the vertical axis measures the score as a percentage, ranging from 0 to 80. The chart shows that the "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model consistently achieves higher scores than the "LLaMA-3-8B-it" model across all nine benchmarks. For instance, on the GSM-8K benchmark, the "Ours" model scores approximately 80%, while the LLaMA-3-8B-it model scores around 79%. This trend continues, with the "Ours" model scoring around 65% on MMLU and 64% on HumanEval, compared to 65% and 61% for LLaMA-3-8B-it, respectively. The largest performance gap is observed on the LC AlpacaEval-2 benchmark, where the "Ours" model scores approximately 31% compared to 23% for LLaMA-3-8B-it. The chart visually demonstrates that the Iterative RLHF approach outperforms the base LLaMA-3-8B-it model on all evaluated academic and practical benchmarks.
